## `neuro.string.matchAll`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Matches a string with a regular expression, and returns an iterable of matches
> containing the results of that search.

## Signatures

```ts
matchAll(input: { string: <receiver>; regexp: RegExp; prompt?: string }): Promise<RegExpStringIterator<RegExpExecArray>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.matchAll` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example

<Code
  lang="ts"
  code={atob("")}
  wrap
/>
